疑为: Mr. David Jackson, a staff writer at the New Yorker, is known for …
理由: 称谓 Mr. 被单独切成一句，应与第 10 句连读；翻译把“大卫·杰克逊先生”放在第 9 句，第 10 句接着译。

原: To find new drugs, scientists screen molecules.
疑为: To find new drugs, scientists screen molecules to predict how effective they might be. Typically, such screening is done by humans in the lab …
理由: 句号切错：to predict how effective they might be 属于第 86 句，第 87 句应从 Typically 开始。

原: The gold standard of lie detection by training yourself in breathing techniques and symptom suppression.
疑为: (You can even beat) the gold standard of lie detection by training yourself in breathing techniques and symptom suppression.
理由: 句子缺谓语，应接上一句 It’s even relatively easy to fool lie detectors, the gold standard of lie detection, by training yourself …；按“练呼吸技巧、压住症状就能骗过测谎的金标准”译。

原: He has been overwhelmed with patients who have fallen on the winter ice?
疑为: He has been overwhelmed with patients who have fallen on the winter ice.
理由: 陈述句，问号应为句号；按陈述句译。

原: She wrote, to properly build wealth, experts recommend saving 20%.
疑为: … experts recommend saving 20% of your income and living off the remaining 80%. Having confidence is another key characteristic …
理由: 句号切在 20% 与 of your income 之间，第 184 句的逗号处才是句界。
